method.title: Method
method.default: For each user-supplied national-percentile endpoint: ceil((100 − percentile) × unique appeared / 100), bounded to 1..N.

limitation.title: Limitation
limitation.default: Illustrative rank range, not an official AIR or calibrated mock-score prediction. Ties, shifts, best-session normalization and current-year participation can change actual rank. Platform percentile is never substituted for NTA percentile.

disclosure.title: Disclosure
disclosure.default: AI generated by gpt-6-astra from the original question image and the supplied key. AI can make mistakes; the supplied key and your sealed score are never changed by it.

rank_formula.title: Rank Formula
rank_formula.default: 1 + number of eligible first-attempt profiles with a strictly higher score. Ties share rank.

percentile_formula.title: Percentile Formula
percentile_formula.default: 100 × profiles scoring at or below your first-attempt score / eligible profiles. Ties are included.

scope.title: Scope
scope.default: First submitted original practice attempt per phone profile, same paper/content/key/rules snapshot. Profiles are not verified unique individuals; this is not an official percentile.

note.title: Note
note.default: Uses your probability assumption and this attempt’s frozen ordinary marking rule. Not a prediction, admission estimate, or instruction to attempt a question.

source_note.title: Source Note
source_note.default: Original PDF questions with matched supplied explanations or answer keys; independent practice, not an NTA service.

disclosure.title: Disclosure
disclosure.default: Two separate Astra passes are checked for agreement and against the supplied key. AI agreement does not guarantee correctness; your sealed score is never changed.
